name: Doorstop
description: Inhabits a single revolving door in a the Gray Zone office building. The door slows down for some people and speeds up for others. It has preferences.
observed_behavior: Adjusts rotation speed based on criteria that have been extensively studied and never determined. Height, weight, age, augmentation level — none correlate. It just likes some people more.
location: the Gray Zone — Meridian Transit Authority building
story_hooks: The door has been studied by three separate research teams. Two concluded it was mechanical variance. One concluded it was lonely.
